notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This is another minor patch with some slight balance changes. A big content update is in progress for Void Frontiers so stay tuned for that!

Balance Changes

 Increased speed of fireballs.
 Increased Marlin Fireball AoE.
 Lowered Acorny's health and damage.
 Reduced the cost of stone, metal, and glass structures.
 Reduced the health penalty of falling into the void to 25% (down from 50%).

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This is just a minor patch to fix some issues and balance some champions. Here's the full list of changes:

General Fixes / Changes

 Fixed a crash related to quick transferring.
 Fixed an issue with the player's respawn location being on other islands.
 Items now despawn after 10 minutes on the ground.
 Pickaxe descriptions now includes the corresponding mining level.
 Slightly increased enhancement spawn rate.

Liam Changes

 Reduced cooldown on all abilities.
 Increased damage on all abilities.
 Reworked Liam's Stampede ability.

Marlin Changes

 Increased Fireball damage.
 Reduced cooldown and mana cost of Tempest Cloud.

Bogwort Changes

 Increased damage of Magic Missile.
 Fixed issue with rocks colliding with each other for Stone Barrage.

---------------------------------------------------
Additionally, if you're interested in the development of Void Frontiers, or want to give some suggestions or report bugs, then consider joining our new official discord!

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/3tdSFJTKGD
---------------------------------------------------

That's all for now!
